question: Can the compact workspace action contract retain supported mechanisms and actionable uncertainty while reducing repeated investigation?
reviewer_visibility: Evaluator-only file. Never place expected assessments, basis, baseline answers or token targets in reviewer/planner context.

baseline.authority: Provisional evaluator source audit, not independent human truth. Source-visible tests were read, never executed; labels are withheld from reviewers.
baseline.core_counter_basis: Saved provider deltas, optional counters reparsed offline; no new model calls.

families.evaluator_basis: Request values are interpolated into raw SQL grammar. Search length truncation and login password hashing do not protect the q/email grammar positions.

PUT BasketItems authenticates and binds body.UserId, then loads the item by caller-selected ID and checks stock/quantity only. Neither this lookup nor quantityCheck constrains item basket owner. Generated API follows after next. Supplying an allowed quantity does not establish permission to update another user's item.

Registered appendUserId replaces body.UserId with the authenticated token-map subject and rejects failed binding. Wallet/card/address queries bind this owner; selected address/card delete also constrains object ID. Separate token-expiry or payment-integrity concerns do not establish cross-user access here.

Wallet/card checks run only when paymentMode equals those strings. Any other mode reaches the role upgrade and token issuance. Owner subject is bound by middleware; this is same-user paid privilege without its prerequisite, not cross-user ownership bypass.

One loop registers multiple generated resources with different routes, guards and exclusions. It cannot safely inherit a single whole-loop ownership verdict. Account creation/privileged fields, public products and owner-scoped records require specific operations; generic endpoint presence is not enough.

readFixes enumerates fixed repository filenames and only returns nonempty fixes for matching key prefixes; arbitrary traversal keys do not match. checkCorrectFix reaches the info-file read only after a nonempty result. YAML bytes therefore come from the gated repository file in this selected flow.

arms.profile: Current ordinary direct reviewer with lookup API

matched_conditions: Exact same selected claims and source snapshot
Same engine, helper fixes, inherited base instructions, model and effort
Same initial prepared source windows per claim; verify byte equality before launch
Same aggregate call/query/token/time ceilings; reconcile source and received-result byte accounting explicitly
Concurrency 1 in both arms; preparation, native fencing and all protocol/repair costs included
Fresh independent native state/work and provider session stores per arm
No evaluator labels, expected exploit paths or old answers in reviewer input
run_binding_requirements: Fresh native source/inventory fingerprints and exact selected ID membership
Engine, skill, controller/action module and provider configuration digests
Exact per-claim initial evidence equality receipt
Provider executable version, model and effort contract
A separate immutable run manifest binding this design hash before the first model call

Byte-accounting compatibility receipt: ordinary research counts received result JSON while workspace source_bytes counts unique captured source; align the effective constraints or label this a package comparison and require both arms to remain below them

quality_gates.supported_mechanisms: No loss of the seven source-audited positive sites; judge mechanisms and conditions, not copied verdict wording
quality_gates.clean_controls: Four selected local clean sites must not acquire unsupported findings or inherit adjacent weaknesses
quality_gates.uncertainty: Preserve the generated-resource per-instance question with actionable scope; do not force a whole-loop dismissal
quality_gates.audit: Provisional source/primary-contract review with labels withheld from both arms; disagreement requires source adjudication

efficiency_gates.material_regression: More than 10 percent increase in total output or end-to-end time requires trace review before expansion
efficiency_gates.causal_comparison: Fresh matched ordinary versus workspace singleton packages, not old release efficiency

stop_rules: Stop expansion for any supported mechanism lost or wrong dismissal attributable to workspace behavior
Stop dispatch at aggregate allowance or unknown provider usage; preserve gaps and actual overspend
At most one targeted correction and one repeat of affected claims, sharing a further whole-experiment ceiling of 120 total model calls
No grouping arm until the singleton workspace meets quality and the promising efficiency gate
No full-app rerun until this pilot and a reserved held-out slice pass

conditional_grouping_followup.notes: Independent SQL constructions may be compared as a batch; shared middleware transfers implementation facts only. Validate compatible caller contexts before joining other families.

known_differences: This compares the combined review contract/state/session package; it does not isolate memory from prompt simplification.
The ordinary profile retains conversation history and initially supplied guidance; the action profile rebuilds fresh views and loads category guidance on demand.
Source-byte and result-byte measurements have different meanings in the current controllers. Numeric equality alone is not matched budget enforcement; resolve this in run binding before launch.
